import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix246Pulse
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPerm252

/-!
Unbounded unary-register excursions of the exact contextual-fold246 table.

This is a direct port of the checked Prefix250Boxes proofs. The local pulse
uses the retained state255 read-one row after its zero-branch self-return.
Every other row used by these excursions is unchanged in original labels.
The generic list encoding and table-parametric return scanner are reused
from RegisterBoxesPerm252/RegisterMarkPerm252; no252 execution theorem is used.

Source63 supplies the contextual folds; the shared-carry macros came from
source58 (incoming zfc-prefix250, arrival126d12e470). The original binary
machine is Mira-Cult's, its original verification is Jeff's, and the compiler
framework is Wade's. Existing helpers retain their public Box.v attribution.

All natural register values, arbitrary finite left context, and the entire
zero-exterior tape are covered. INC appends one value-one spare; positive CD
moves the boundary one cell right; zero CD requires an actual following block.
No blank bootstrap, all-sites acceptance or consistency endpoint is asserted.
-/
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix246Boxes

open FiniteZipper ZipperRuns RegisterBoxesPerm252

abbrev carry : Fin 246 := oldStatePrefix246 95
abbrev carryProbe : Fin 246 := oldStatePrefix246 109
abbrev test : Fin 246 := oldStatePrefix246 75
abbrev seek : Fin 246 := oldStatePrefix246 73
abbrev seekProbe : Fin 246 := oldStatePrefix246 83
abbrev returnOnes : Fin 246 := oldStatePrefix246 63
abbrev returnZero : Fin 246 := oldStatePrefix246 48
abbrev rollback : Fin 246 := oldStatePrefix246 112
abbrev rollbackProbe : Fin 246 := oldStatePrefix246 131

/-- An ordinary block 01^(v+1) after the forward carry has crossed it. -/
def carryBits : List Nat → List Bool
  | [] => []
  | v :: vs => true :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ carryBits vs)

/-- The same crossed blocks in nearest-first order on the left half-tape. -/
def carryLeft : List Nat → List Bool
  | [] => []
  | v :: vs => List.replicate v true ++ false :: true :: carryLeft vs

private theorem ones_snoc (v : Nat) (l : List Bool) :
    List.replicate v true ++ true :: l = true :: (List.replicate v true ++ l) := by
  calc
    _ = (List.replicate v true ++ [true]) ++ l := (List.append_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [← List.replicate_succ', List.replicate_succ]; rfl

theorem carryBits_append (a b : List Nat) :
    carryBits (a ++ b) = carryBits a ++ carryBits b := by
  induction a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v a ih => simp [carryBits, ih]

theorem carryLeft_append (a b : List Nat) :
    carryLeft (a ++ b) = carryLeft a ++ carryLeft b := by
  induction a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v a ih => simp [carryLeft, ih, List.append_assoc]

theorem reverse_carryBits (vs : List Nat) :
    (carryBits vs).reverse = carryLeft vs.reverse := by
  induction vs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v vs ih =>
    simp [carryBits, List.reverse_append, ih, carryLeft_append, carryLeft,
      List.append_assoc]

/-- The last carried one turns the crossed prefix into a one-cell right shift. -/
theorem carryBits_snoc (pre : List Nat) (X : List Bool) :
    carryBits pre ++ true :: X = true :: (registerBits pre ++ X) := by
  induction pre with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v pre ih =>
    simp only [carryBits, registerBits, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
    rw [ih, ones_snoc]

private theorem reverse_carry_snoc (pre : List Nat) (l : List Bool) :
    true :: ((carryBits pre).reverse ++ l) =
      (registerBits pre).reverse ++ true :: l := by
  have hr := congrArg List.reverse (carryBits_snoc pre [])
  simp only [List.append_nil, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons,
    List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, List.singleton_append] at hr
  calc
    _ = (true :: (carryBits pre).reverse) ++ l := rfl
    _ = ((registerBits pre).reverse ++ [true]) ++ l := congrArg (fun t => t ++ l) hr
    _ = _ := by simp only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]

/-- Forward carry crosses a separator, replacing01 by10. -/
theorem carry_separator (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246 (zAt carry h l (false :: true :: X)) 2 =
      zAt carry (h + 2) (false :: true :: l) X := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old95_false,
    zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old109_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem carry_block (v : Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt carry h l (false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) (v + 2) =
      zAt carry (h + ((v + 2 : Nat) : Int))
        (List.replicate v true ++ false :: true :: l) X := by
  rw [show v + 2 = 2 + v by omega, zipRun_add, carry_separator,
    scan_right _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old95_true]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- This induction is over all prefix lengths and all unary block values. -/
theorem carry_file (pre : List Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246 (zAt carry h l (registerBits pre ++ X)) (width pre) =
      zAt carry (h + (width pre : Int)) ((carryBits pre).reverse ++ l) X := by
  induction pre generalizing h l with
  | nil => simp [registerBits, carryBits, width, zipRun]
  | cons v pre ih =>
    simp only [width, registerBits, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
    rw [zipRun_add, carry_block, ih]
    simp only [carryBits, List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_replicate,
      List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
    congr 1
    omega

/-- Two forward steps arrive at the test cell after the marked00. -/
theorem carry_mark (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246 (zAt carry h l (false :: false :: X)) 2 =
      zAt test (h + 2) (false :: true :: l) X := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old95_false,
    zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old109_false]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- The existing return scanner instantiated on three literal246 rows. -/
theorem return_separator (pre : List Nat) (h : Int) (l Y : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt returnOnes h ((registerBits pre).reverse ++ l) (false :: Y))
      (width pre + 1) =
      leftAt returnZero (h - (width pre : Int)) l (registerBits pre ++ false :: Y) := by
  simpa only [reverse_registerBits, width_reverse, List.reverse_reverse] using
    RegisterMarkPerm252.return_separator_left machinePrefix246 returnOnes returnZero
      rowPrefix246_old63_true rowPrefix246_old63_false rowPrefix246_old48_true
      pre.reverse h l Y

/-- A positive selected value v+1 is decreased to v. The boundary moves right one cell;
the final head is at the old origin, which now contains the added left one. -/
theorem positive_decrement_zip (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt carry h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ registerBits rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 4) =
      zAt returnZero h l (true :: registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)) := by
  rw [show 2 * width pre + 4 = width pre + (2 + ((width pre + 1) + 1)) by omega,
    zipRun_add, carry_file, zipRun_add, carry_mark]
  rw [reverse_carry_snoc]
  simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append]
  rw [zipRun_first, step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old75_true,
    leftAt_cons, return_separator, leftAt_cons]
  simp only [registerBits_append, registerBits, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- The reverse carry changes a crossed 10 pair back to 01. -/
theorem rollback_pair (h : Int) (l Y : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246 (leftAt rollback h (false :: true :: l) Y) 2 =
      leftAt rollback (h - 2) l (false :: true :: Y) := by
  rw [leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old112_false,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old131_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Restore every crossed block, starting with the nearest block. -/
theorem rollback_left (rp : List Nat) (h : Int) (l Y : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246 (leftAt rollback h (carryLeft rp ++ l) Y) (width rp) =
      leftAt rollback (h - (width rp : Int)) l (registerBits rp.reverse ++ Y) := by
  induction rp generalizing h Y with
  | nil => simp [width, carryLeft, registerBits, zipRun]
  | cons v rp ih =>
    simp only [width, carryLeft, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append]
    rw [show v + 2 + width rp = v + (2 + width rp) by omega,
      zipRun_add, scan_left _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old112_true,
      zipRun_add, rollback_pair, ih]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons, registerBits_append, registerBits,
      List.append_nil, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append]
    congr 1
    omega

theorem rollback_file (pre : List Nat) (h : Int) (l Y : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (leftAt rollback h ((carryBits pre).reverse ++ l) Y) (width pre) =
      leftAt rollback (h - (width pre : Int)) l (registerBits pre ++ Y) := by
  simpa only [reverse_carryBits, width_reverse, List.reverse_reverse] using
    rollback_left pre.reverse h l Y

/-- On a marked zero followed by an ordinary block, restore the selected 01
and prepare the backwards restoration of the preceding crossed prefix. -/
theorem zero_restore (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt test h (false :: true :: l) (false :: true :: X)) 5 =
      leftAt rollback (h - 2) l (false :: true :: false :: true :: X) := by
  rw [show 5 = 3 + 2 by decide, zipRun_add, Prefix246Pulse.pulse_zero_one,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old112_false,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old131_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- A zero selected register is restored, with output state112 rather than
old 3. The explicit first following block is essential for the zero test. -/
theorem zero_decrement_zip (pre : List Nat) (next : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt carry h l (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: registerBits (next :: rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 7) =
      leftAt rollback h l (registerBits (pre ++ 0 :: next :: rest)) := by
  rw [show 2 * width pre + 7 = width pre + (2 + (5 + width pre)) by omega,
    zipRun_add, carry_file, zipRun_add, carry_mark]
  simp only [registerBits]
  rw [zipRun_add, zero_restore, rollback_file]
  simp only [registerBits_append, registerBits, List.replicate_zero,
    List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- The increment seeker passes an ordinary block unchanged. -/
theorem seek_block (v : Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt seek h l (false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) (v + 2) =
      zAt seek (h + ((v + 2 : Nat) : Int))
        (List.replicate v true ++ true :: false :: l) X := by
  rw [show v + 2 = (v + 1) + 1 by omega, zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old73_false, zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old83_true,
    scan_right _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old73_true]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem seek_file (pre : List Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246 (zAt seek h l (registerBits pre ++ X)) (width pre) =
      zAt seek (h + (width pre : Int)) ((registerBits pre).reverse ++ l) X := by
  induction pre generalizing h l with
  | nil => simp [registerBits, width, zipRun]
  | cons v pre ih =>
    simp only [width, registerBits, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
    rw [zipRun_add, seek_block, ih]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_replicate,
      List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
    congr 1
    omega

theorem restore_mark (v : Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt seek h l (false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) 2 =
      zAt carry (h + 2) (true :: false :: l) (List.replicate v true ++ X) := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old73_false,
    zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old83_false]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

private theorem step_right_blank (q q' : Fin 246) (written : Bool)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (ht : machinePrefix246.transition q false = ⟨written, .right, some q'⟩) :
    zipStep machinePrefix246 (zAt q h l []) =
      zAt q' (h + 1) (written :: l) [] := by
  simp [zipStep, zAt, ht, zipWrite, zipRight]

private theorem step_left_blank (q q' : Fin 246) (written : Bool)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (ht : machinePrefix246.transition q false = ⟨written, .left, some q'⟩) :
    zipStep machinePrefix246 (zAt q h l []) = leftAt q' h l [written] := by
  simp [zipStep, zAt, leftAt, ht, zipWrite, zipLeft]

/-- The same zero/zero pulse at the finite representation's blank exterior.
Both previously implicit cells become explicit because they are written. -/
private theorem pulse_blank (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246 (zAt test h l []) 3 =
      leftAt rollbackProbe h l [true, true] := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right_blank _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old75_false,
    zipRun_first, step_left_blank _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old255_false,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old255_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Reaching the file's blank end appends 011 and turns left. -/
theorem carry_end (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246 (zAt carry h l []) 6 =
      leftAt returnZero (h + 1) (true :: l) [false, true, true] := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right_blank _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old95_false,
    zipRun_first, step_right_blank _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old109_false,
    show 4 = 3 + 1 by decide, zipRun_add, pulse_blank, leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old131_false]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Carry through every following register and spare. Only the zero exterior
is special; all existing suffix values are arbitrary natural numbers. -/
theorem shift_suffix (rest : List Nat) (a : Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt carry h l (List.replicate a true ++ registerBits rest))
      (a + width rest + 6) =
      leftAt returnZero (h + ((a + width rest + 1 : Nat) : Int))
        ((List.replicate (a + 1) true ++ registerBits rest).reverse ++ l)
        [false, true, true] := by
  induction rest generalizing a h l with
  | nil =>
    simp only [width, registerBits, Nat.add_zero]
    rw [zipRun_add _ _ a 6, scan_right _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old95_true, carry_end]
    rw [List.append_nil, List.reverse_replicate, List.replicate_succ]
    congr 1
    omega
  | cons v rest ih =>
    simp only [width, registerBits, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
    rw [show a + (v + 2 + width rest) + 6 = a + (2 + (v + width rest + 6)) by omega,
      zipRun_add, scan_right _ _ _ rowPrefix246_old95_true,
      zipRun_add, carry_separator, ih]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_replicate,
      List.singleton_append, List.append_assoc, List.replicate_succ]
    simp only [ones_snoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    congr 1
    omega

/-- The complete increment excursion. Exactly one value-one spare is appended;
all prior suffix registers and all exterior cells are retained. -/
theorem increment_zip (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt seek h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)))
      (2 * width (pre ++ v :: rest) + 7) =
      leftAt returnZero h l (registerBits ((pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest) ++ [1])) := by
  have hne : pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest ≠ [] := by simp
  have firstCount : 2 * width (pre ++ v :: rest) + 7 =
      width pre + (2 + ((v + width rest + 6) + width (pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest))) := by
    simp only [width_append, width]
    omega
  rw [firstCount, zipRun_add, seek_file, zipRun_add]
  simp only [List.append_assoc]
  rw [restore_mark, zipRun_add, shift_suffix]
  have frame :
      (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ registerBits rest).reverse ++
        true :: false :: ((registerBits pre).reverse ++ l) =
      (registerBits (pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest)).reverse ++ l := by
    simp only [registerBits_append, registerBits, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons,
      List.reverse_replicate, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
  rw [frame, RegisterMarkPerm252.return_end machinePrefix246 returnOnes returnZero
    rowPrefix246_old63_true rowPrefix246_old63_false rowPrefix246_old48_true
    _ hne returnZero rowPrefix246_old48_true]
  simp only [registerBits_append, registerBits, List.replicate_succ,
    List.replicate_zero, List.nil_append, List.append_nil, List.append_assoc]
  congr 1
  simp only [width_append, width]
  omega

/-- The same positive endpoint in boundary notation: the file origin moves
right by one and the arbitrary old left context gains exactly one one-cell. -/
theorem positive_decrement_boundary (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt carry h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ registerBits rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 4) =
      leftAt returnZero (h + 1) (true :: l) (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)) := by
  rw [positive_decrement_zip, leftAt_cons]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Whole-tape Core contract for positive decrement, with exact duration. -/
theorem positive_decrement {c : Config 246} (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat)
    (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt carry h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ registerBits rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix246.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 4))
      (zAt returnZero h l (true :: registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest))) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machinePrefix246 (2 * width pre + 4) hc
  rw [positive_decrement_zip] at hs
  exact hs

/-- Whole-tape Core contract for zero decrement. The following block can have
any value; its existence is the strengthened runtime invariant's premise. -/
theorem zero_decrement {c : Config 246} (pre : List Nat) (next : Nat)
    (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c
      (zAt carry h l (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: registerBits (next :: rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix246.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 7))
      (leftAt rollback h l (registerBits (pre ++ 0 :: next :: rest))) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machinePrefix246 (2 * width pre + 7) hc
  rw [zero_decrement_zip] at hs
  exact hs

/-- Whole-tape Core contract for increment and its new spare block. -/
theorem increment {c : Config 246} (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat)
    (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt seek h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix246.runFrom c (2 * width (pre ++ v :: rest) + 7))
      (leftAt returnZero h l (registerBits ((pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest) ++ [1]))) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machinePrefix246 (2 * width (pre ++ v :: rest) + 7) hc
  rw [increment_zip] at hs
  exact hs

/-- A selected index below 9 in a file with at least 10 blocks has a following
block. No bound is placed on its value or on the length of the suffix. -/
theorem following_nonempty (pre rest : List Nat) (v : Nat)
    (hp : pre.length < 9) (hf : 10 ≤ (pre ++ v :: rest).length) : rest ≠ [] := by
  intro he
  subst rest
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hf
  omega

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix246Boxes

example : Prefix246Boxes.returnZero = oldStatePrefix246 48 := rfl
example : Prefix246Boxes.rollback = oldStatePrefix246 112 := rfl

example (pre : List Nat) (X : List Bool) :
    carryBits pre ++ true :: X = true :: (registerBits pre ++ X) :=
  carryBits_snoc pre X

example (pre : List Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt Prefix246Boxes.carry h l (registerBits pre ++ X)) (width pre) =
      zAt Prefix246Boxes.carry (h + (width pre : Int)) ((carryBits pre).reverse ++ l) X :=
  carry_file pre h l X

example (pre : List Nat) (h : Int) (l Y : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (leftAt Prefix246Boxes.rollback h ((carryBits pre).reverse ++ l) Y) (width pre) =
      leftAt Prefix246Boxes.rollback (h - (width pre : Int)) l (registerBits pre ++ Y) :=
  rollback_file pre h l Y

example (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt Prefix246Boxes.carry h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ registerBits rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 4) =
      zAt Prefix246Boxes.returnZero h l (true :: registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)) :=

example (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt Prefix246Boxes.carry h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ registerBits rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 4) =
      leftAt Prefix246Boxes.returnZero (h + 1) (true :: l) (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)) :=
  positive_decrement_boundary pre v rest h l

example (pre : List Nat) (next : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt Prefix246Boxes.carry h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: registerBits (next :: rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 7) =
      leftAt Prefix246Boxes.rollback h l (registerBits (pre ++ 0 :: next :: rest)) :=
  zero_decrement_zip pre next rest h l

example (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt Prefix246Boxes.seek h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)))
      (2 * width (pre ++ v :: rest) + 7) =
      leftAt Prefix246Boxes.returnZero h l (registerBits ((pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest) ++ [1])) :=
  increment_zip pre v rest h l

example (c : Config 246) (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt Prefix246Boxes.carry h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ registerBits rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix246.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 4))
      (zAt Prefix246Boxes.returnZero h l (true :: registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest))) :=
  positive_decrement pre v rest h l hc

example (c : Config 246) (pre : List Nat) (next : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt Prefix246Boxes.carry h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: registerBits (next :: rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix246.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 7))
      (leftAt Prefix246Boxes.rollback h l (registerBits (pre ++ 0 :: next :: rest))) :=
  zero_decrement pre next rest h l hc

example (c : Config 246) (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt Prefix246Boxes.seek h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machinePrefix246.runFrom c (2 * width (pre ++ v :: rest) + 7))
      (leftAt Prefix246Boxes.returnZero h l (registerBits ((pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest) ++ [1]))) :=
  increment pre v rest h l hc

example (pre rest : List Nat) (v : Nat)
    (hp : pre.length < 9) (hf : 10 ≤ (pre ++ v :: rest).length) : rest ≠ [] :=
  following_nonempty pre rest v hp hf

-- The positive contract includes physical register0 and an empty spare suffix;
-- only the zero contract requires an actual following block.
example (v : Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machinePrefix246
      (zAt Prefix246Boxes.carry h l (false :: false :: List.replicate (v + 1) true)) 4 =
      zAt Prefix246Boxes.returnZero h l (true :: registerBits [v]) := by
  simpa only [registerBits, width, List.nil_append, List.append_nil,
    Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_add] using positive_decrement_zip [] v [] h l

-- Every positive-decrement duration is positive, uniformly in all values.
example (pre : List Nat) : 0 < 2 * width pre + 4 := by omega
example (pre : List Nat) : 0 < 2 * width pre + 7 := by omega
example (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat) :
    0 < 2 * width (pre ++ v :: rest) + 7 := by omega

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded exact246 unbounded register-box proof; eight project providers, no rebuild.
The Pulse PASS record pin must be frozen after the root's successful pulse run.
Prepare-only performs no compiler or version invocation. Proof mode compiles
only Prefix246Boxes and its focused audit, serially, with a fresh output object.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, time

MODULE = 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix246Boxes'
PREFIX = 'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix246Boxes.'
SOURCE_SHA = 'af1070a0840f4bcf05ffadef7042b246a6a9022d8acc770f33b58c5e5e51ee54'
AUDIT_SHA = '38408d5b15c449603b582a28af7491706e26221b3d565a1525d1143451a1cea3'
PULSE_RECORD_SHA = 'a51632e7a25ba048d8a988a07546637a8937649aec48303d167886f6b16b69e1'
MP_RECORD_SHA = '92c2bddc7390806e81b30daa15c2bcfe082dcae6555392a57fe6d1ae987df81b'
EXPECTED = {
    'BusyBeaver.Core': ('436336133fa107c62eb00322333ec9451a0705964bd2b62fce3f44ce848672a6', '2c18d0fc971038cdd3cf5998857f56a88ea1cf33cd11f90f6794866fcc2e1148'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.FiniteZipper': ('f7b41631975f0c243bcb6e48a6c566adde0866fb93f7105571e310c18db45066', 'bfbfb31d4cd560b52a65a832777d64f544dc6a1bbbb080829cc1465881d44101'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.ZipperRuns': ('fc8f39330f6551fb2b29db22127efbb361dd421290b47ca95d1088d7104a3d48', 'f6280bb230bb5f816c27fcd7789aa16a3890d5a0ac3c0d74bd4ac9a19006e8b6'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePerm252': ('d216d7292acf690095048024e2cae2575195ded015acf8e235261b8152e74bd0', '62f26b312a448576ae3b83dbeb336a844fbcf9e1341e67aec79114e553dd67c3'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterBoxesPerm252': ('da0a5c460aba89b9d46dc794fad70a98ac441238ed26c5f7287fa4797a0bd5e7', 'ca74f3f602f975958c6c316071dfc151d1b73d4dcc33c34ce19bc8b07fe76c3e'),
    'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPerm252': ('c646007b54f2d32242f593a60eb770834f3e085a03ee60beb1275aebb796ce41', '6d661f5afac61d31ae82fe20e5c2420216fe2bdb866dbabf5572455061df200c'),
}
PROBES = ['carryBits_snoc', 'carry_file', 'return_separator', 'positive_decrement_zip', 'rollback_file', 'zero_decrement_zip', 'carry_end', 'shift_suffix', 'increment_zip', 'positive_decrement_boundary', 'positive_decrement', 'zero_decrement', 'increment', 'following_nonempty']
CALLERS = 19
TIMEOUT = 120

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--pulse-evidence', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--source', type=Path)
p.add_argument('--audit', type=Path)
p.add_argument('--prepare-only', action='store_true')
a = p.parse_args()
if not __debug__:
    p.error('Assertions must remain enabled.')
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
R = a.repo.resolve()
W = a.output.resolve()
assert not W.is_relative_to(R) and (not W.exists() or not any(W.iterdir()))
assert PULSE_RECORD_SHA != 'PENDING_SUCCESSFUL_PULSE_RECORD', 'Freeze successful pulse evidence before preparation or compilation.'
S = a.source.resolve() if a.source else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix246-lean/boxes/Prefix246Boxes.lean')
A = a.audit.resolve() if a.audit else Path('/tmp/zfc-prefix246-lean/boxes/Audit.lean')
assert sha(S) == SOURCE_SHA and sha(A) == AUDIT_SHA
E = a.pulse_evidence.resolve()
MP = R / 'Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/arithmetic-control-mp254-verification.json'
assert sha(E) == PULSE_RECORD_SHA and sha(MP) == MP_RECORD_SHA
parent, mp = json.loads(E.read_text()), json.loads(MP.read_text())
for d in (parent, mp):
    assert d['status'] == 'PASS' and d['only_standard_axioms']
    assert d['all_input_provider_postchecks'] and d['all_fresh_objects_unchanged_after_audit']
    assert len(d['commands']) == 2 and all(q['exit_code'] == 0 for q in d['commands'])
    assert [q['label'] for q in d['commands']] == ['source', 'audit']
C = Path(parent['compiler']['path']).resolve()
assert parent['compiler']['sha256'] == mp['compiler']['sha256'] == sha(C)
assert parent['compiler']['version'] == mp['compiler']['version']
version = parent['compiler']['version']
toolroot = C.parent.parent / 'lib/lean'

def imports(path):
    text = Path(path).read_text()
    return re.findall(r'^import\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\s*$', text, re.M)

assert imports(S) == ['BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix246Pulse', 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPerm252']
assert imports(A) == [MODULE]
assert re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\S+)$', A.read_text(), re.M) == [PREFIX + n for n in PROBES]
assert len(re.findall(r'^example\b', A.read_text(), re.M)) == CALLERS
# Reject new unchecked proof exits and enlarged elaboration budgets.
for f in (S, A):
    assert not re.search(r'\b(sorry|admit|native_decide)\b', f.read_text())
    assert not re.search(r'set_option\s+(maxHeartbeats|maxRecDepth)', f.read_text())
pool = {q['module']: q for q in mp['reused_modules']}
selected = {}
for m, (source_sha, object_sha) in EXPECTED.items():
    q = pool[m]
    source = R / 'Computability/BusyBeaver/Lean' / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.lean')
    obj = Path(q['object']).resolve()
    assert q['source_sha256'] == source_sha == sha(source)
    assert q['object_sha256'] == object_sha == sha(obj)
    selected[m] = dict(module=m, source=str(source), source_sha256=source_sha,
                       object=str(obj), object_sha256=object_sha, evidence=str(MP))
# Recheck the exact pulse source-PASS object recorded before its audit.
assert parent['source_object_recorded_before_audit']
fresh = [q for q in parent['fresh_modules'] if q['module'] == 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.Prefix246Pulse']
assert len(fresh) == 1
q = fresh[0]
pulse_source = Path(parent['source']['path']).resolve()
pulse_snapshot = Path(parent['source']['snapshot']).resolve()
assert q['source_sha256'] == parent['source']['sha256'] == sha(pulse_source) == sha(pulse_snapshot)
pulse_object = Path(q['path']).resolve()
assert sha(pulse_object) == q['sha256']
assert parent['source_pass_object'] == q
selected[q['module']] = dict(module=q['module'], source=str(pulse_source),
    source_sha256=sha(pulse_source), object=str(pulse_object), object_sha256=sha(pulse_object), evidence=str(E))
# Every old provider used to check the pulse must agree with the selected closure.
for q in parent['reused_modules']:
    if q['module'] in EXPECTED:
        assert (q['source_sha256'], q['object_sha256']) == EXPECTED[q['module']]
# Reuse the exact table provider already used by the successful pulse proof.
pt = [q for q in parent['reused_modules'] if q['module'] == 'BusyBeaver.ZFC.TablePrefix246']
assert len(pt) == 1
q = pt[0]
table_source = Path(q['source']).resolve()
table_object = Path(q['object']).resolve()
assert sha(table_source) == q['source_sha256'] and sha(table_object) == q['object_sha256']
selected[q['module']] = dict(module=q['module'], source=str(table_source),
    source_sha256=q['source_sha256'], object=str(table_object), object_sha256=q['object_sha256'], evidence=q['evidence'])
# Preserve and verify the evidence record that supplied that table object.
TE = Path(q['evidence']).resolve()
te_pin = [e for e in parent['provider_evidence'] if Path(e['path']).resolve() == TE]
assert len(te_pin) == 1 and sha(TE) == te_pin[0]['sha256']
te = json.loads(TE.read_text())
assert te['status'] == 'PASS' and te['only_standard_axioms']
assert te['all_input_provider_postchecks'] and te['all_fresh_objects_unchanged_after_audit']
assert te['compiler']['sha256'] == sha(C) and te['compiler']['version'] == version
tf = [x for x in te['fresh_modules'] if x['module'] == q['module']]
assert len(tf) == 1 and tf[0]['sha256'] == q['object_sha256']
assert tf[0]['source_sha256'] == q['source_sha256']
visiting, closure, tool_names = set(), [], {'Init'}
def visit(m):
    if m in closure:
        return
    assert m in selected and m not in visiting
    visiting.add(m)
    for n in imports(selected[m]['source']):
        if n == 'Init' or n.startswith(('Lean.', 'Std.')):
            tool_names.add(n)
        else:
            visit(n)
    visiting.remove(m)
    closure.append(m)
for m in imports(S):
    visit(m)
assert set(closure) == set(selected) and len(closure) == 8
W.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cache, snap = W / 'cache', W / 'sources'
cache.mkdir()
ss = snap / Path(MODULE.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.lean')
ss.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
aa = snap / 'Audit.lean'
shutil.copyfile(S, ss)
shutil.copyfile(A, aa)
for m in closure:
    dest = cache / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest.symlink_to(selected[m]['object'])
def first(m):
    rel = Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    return next(q / rel for q in (cache, toolroot) if (q / rel).is_file())
actual = []
for m in closure:
    obj = first(m)
    assert sha(obj) == selected[m]['object_sha256']
    actual.append(dict(module=m, actual_first=str(obj), resolved=str(obj.resolve()), sha256=sha(obj)))
tools = []
for m in sorted(tool_names):
    ref = toolroot / Path(m.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    obj = first(m)
    assert obj.resolve() == ref.resolve()
    tools.append(dict(module=m, object=str(ref), object_sha256=sha(ref), actual_first=str(obj)))
inputs = [Path(__file__).resolve(), S, A, E, TE, MP, C, pulse_snapshot, ss, aa]
for q in selected.values():
    inputs += [Path(q['source']), Path(q['object'])]
inputs += [Path(q['object']) for q in tools]
inputs = list(dict.fromkeys(q.resolve() for q in inputs))
before = {str(q): sha(q) for q in inputs}
env = dict(os.environ, LEAN_PATH=str(cache), LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1')
r = dict(status='PREPARED_NOT_BUILT' if a.prepare_only else 'RUNNING', scope=__doc__,
    prepare_only=a.prepare_only, compiler=dict(path=str(C), version=version, sha256=sha(C),
    compiler_version_query_performed=False), source_overridden=a.source is not None,
    audit_overridden=a.audit is not None, source=dict(path=str(S), sha256=sha(S), snapshot=str(ss)),
    audit=dict(path=str(A), sha256=sha(A), snapshot=str(aa)),
    provider_evidence=[dict(path=str(q), sha256=sha(q)) for q in (E, TE, MP)],
    reused_modules=[selected[m] for m in closure], exact_project_import_closure=True,
    project_module_count=8, external_project_boundaries=[], toolchain_providers=tools,
    actual_first_providers=actual, actual_direct_tool_imports=sorted(tool_names),
    before=before, commands=[], fresh_modules=[], LEAN_PATH=env['LEAN_PATH'],
    dependency_build=False, downloads=False, per_command_timeout_seconds=TIMEOUT,
    shared_wall_seconds=TIMEOUT)
def save():
    (W / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
def post():
    after = {str(q): sha(q) for q in inputs}
    assert before == after
    for m in closure:
        assert sha(first(m)) == selected[m]['object_sha256']
    for q in tools:
        assert sha(first(q['module'])) == q['object_sha256']
    r.update(after=after, all_input_provider_postchecks=True)
save()
if a.prepare_only:
    post()
    save()
    print(W / 'verification.json')
    raise SystemExit(0)
deadline = time.monotonic() + TIMEOUT
def run(label, source, obj=None):
    cmd = [str(C), '-j1', '-M4096', '--root=' + str(snap)]
    if obj is not None:
        cmd += ['-o', str(obj)]
    cmd += [str(source)]
    began = time.monotonic()
    remaining = deadline - began
    assert remaining > 0, 'Shared proof wall budget exhausted.'
    try:
        cp = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=snap, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=remaining)
        output, code = cp.stdout + cp.stderr, cp.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as ex:
        def decoded(x):
            return x.decode(errors='replace') if isinstance(x, bytes) else x or ''
        output, code = decoded(ex.stdout) + decoded(ex.stderr) + '\nTIMEOUT\n', -1
    (W / (label + '.log')).write_text(output)
    r['commands'].append(dict(label=label, command=cmd, seconds=time.monotonic() - began,
                              exit_code=code, output=output))
    save()
    assert code == 0 and 'sorryAx' not in output and "declaration uses 'sorry'" not in output, output
    return output
try:
    obj = cache / Path(MODULE.replace('.', '/')).with_suffix('.olean')
    run('source', ss, obj)
    assert obj.is_file() and not obj.is_symlink()
    oh = sha(obj)
    source_object = dict(module=MODULE, path=str(obj), sha256=oh, source_sha256=sha(S))
    r.update(source_object_recorded_before_audit=True, source_pass_object=source_object,
             fresh_modules=[source_object])
    assert first(MODULE).resolve() == obj.resolve()
    r['fresh_first_provider_before_audit'] = dict(module=MODULE, path=str(first(MODULE)), sha256=sha(first(MODULE)))
    save()
    audit_output = run('audit', aa)
    reports = re.findall(r"'([^']+)'\s+(?:depends on axioms:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]|does not depend on any axioms)", audit_output, re.S)
    assert [n for n, _ in reports] == [PREFIX + n for n in PROBES]
    assert all({x.strip() for x in axioms.split(',') if x.strip()} <=
               {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'} for _, axioms in reports)
    post()
    assert sha(obj) == oh and sha(first(MODULE)) == oh
    r.update(status='PASS', all_fresh_objects_unchanged_after_audit=True,
             named_axiom_probes=len(PROBES), callers=CALLERS, only_standard_axioms=True,
             warnings={q['label']: q['output'].count('warning:') for q in r['commands']})
except Exception as ex:
    r.update(status='FAIL', error=str(ex))
    try:
        post()
    except Exception as post_error:
        r['postcheck_error'] = str(post_error)
    save()
    raise
save()
print(W / 'verification.json')
